name: Button
description: Triggers an action. Variants set emphasis; size (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) sets density.

name: IconButton
description: Square button that holds only an icon; always give it an accessible label. Use size (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) to change density.

name: Pressable
description: Unstyled pressable wrapper that gives any custom content a tap feedback and button semantics.

name: CopyButton
description: Copies a value to the clipboard and briefly confirms with a check icon. Use size (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) to change density.

name: ToggleGroup
description: Group of toggle buttons for single or multiple selection, with optional icons. Use size (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) to change density.

variants.label: Single, allowEmpty (click the active one to clear)

name: SegmentedControl
description: Compact switch between a few mutually exclusive views. Use size (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) to change density.

name: FilterChips
description: Row of selectable chips used to filter lists, in single or multi selection mode. Use size (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) to change density.

name: Chip
description: Small label with tone, variant and optional icon or remove button; size (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) sets density.

name: Tag
description: Neutral keyword tag; becomes removable when onRemove is passed. Use size (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) to change density.

name: Badge
description: Tiny status marker or counter, optionally with a leading dot. Use size (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) to change density.

name: Card
description: Glass surface that groups related content with an optional title and actions. The size prop (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) sets the padding and title size.

name: KpiTile
description: Compact metric tile with a label, a value and an optional delta. The size prop (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) sets the padding and value font size.

name: StatsCard
description: Metric card with an icon, a value and an up or down trend. The size prop (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) sets the padding and value font size.

name: MiniChart
description: Tiny sparkline as bars or a line, without axes. The size prop (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) sets the chart height (an explicit height prop wins).

name: Ring
description: Circular progress gauge with a tick scale and a centered value. The size prop (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) sets the diameter (a number in px still works).

name: IconTile
description: Rounded tinted square (or circle) holding an icon. The size prop (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) sets the tile and icon size (a number in px still works).

name: StatusIcon
description: Circular icon badge that shows a tooltip on hover or focus. The size prop (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) sets the badge and icon size (a number in px still works).

name: SocialAuth
description: Google and Apple sign-in buttons. onSelect gets the provider id; wire your OAuth flow there.

name: AuthSplit
description: Two-pane auth layout: the aside prop holds the brand panel, the logo prop the mark, and the default slot is the form.

name: Switch

name: Rating

name: Calendar

description: Circular user picture that falls back to initials. The size prop (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) sets the diameter (24 / 32 / 40 / 56 / 72 px; a number in px still works).

name: Icon
description: Renders a named icon from the built-in set at any size. The size prop (xs, sm, md, lg, xl, or a number in px) sets the icon size.

name: LazyImage
description: Image placeholder with a fixed aspect ratio and rounded corners.

name: TopNav
description: Horizontal app header with brand, navigation items and an actions area. Use size (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) to change density.

name: SideNav
description: Vertical sidebar with grouped items, counters, a footer and optional collapse toggle. Use size (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) to change density.

name: SubNav
description: Secondary vertical menu for sections inside a page, with icons and badges. Use size (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) to change density.

name: Tabs
description: Underlined tab bar for switching between views of the same content. Use size (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) to change density.

name: PillTabs
description: Pill-shaped tabs with optional icons, horizontal or vertical. Use size (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) to change density.

name: Breadcrumbs
description: Shows the path to the current page; the last item is the current location. Use size (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) to change density.

name: Pagination
description: Numbered page buttons with the current page highlighted. Use size (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) to change density.

name: Accordion
description: Vertically stacked sections where one panel can be expanded at a time. Use size (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) to change density.

description: Small inline confirmation popover attached to a trigger button. The size prop (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) sets the trigger button and panel density.

name: BottomSheet
description: Mobile-style sheet that rises from the bottom, with optional title and footer. The size prop (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) sets the sheet width and padding.

name: Tooltip
description: Short hint shown on hover or focus of the wrapped element. The size prop (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) sets the tooltip padding and text.

name: Dropdown
description: Button that opens a menu of actions with icons, shortcuts and separators. The size prop (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) sets the button and menu item density.

name: Menu
description: Static menu list, useful on its own or as the content of custom popups. The size prop (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) sets the item height, padding and text.

name: ContextMenu
description: Right-click menu that opens at the cursor over its content. The size prop (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) sets the item height, padding and text.

name: CommandPalette
description: Searchable command launcher modal with keyboard shortcut hints. The size prop (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) sets the palette width (xs 400px to xl 720px).

name: PagePricing

name: PageAuth
description: Full-screen auth page. Slots: background, logo, aside, form, footer; props: title, subtitle, layout (card or split).

name: PageStatus
description: Full-screen status page. Use kind (404, 401, maintenance, soon) or fill the code, message and action slots.

name: Heading
description: Semantic heading with independent level (h1-h6) and visual size.
